headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for the EEVE Mower Willow. Exposes the mower's camera and battery to HomeKit. Requires `ffmpeg` on the Homebridge host for live camera streaming.

ipAddress.title: Mower IP Address
ipAddress.description: Local IP address of your EEVE Mower Willow (reachable on port 8080).

lowBatteryThreshold.title: Low Battery Threshold (%)
lowBatteryThreshold.description: HomeKit 'Low Battery' alert fires when the battery falls below this level.

ffmpegPath.title: FFmpeg Binary Path
ffmpegPath.description: Full path to the ffmpeg binary. Required for live camera streaming. Leave as 'ffmpeg' if it is on your system PATH.

streamFps.title: Camera Stream FPS
streamFps.description: Frames per second to pull from the mower camera for live streaming. Higher values increase CPU load.
